serverInfo.name: AIShield
serverInfo.description: AI Agent Security Shield — OWASP MCP Top 10 + OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 aligned security scanning. 227 MCP rules (+233 skill rules) covering prompt injection, zero-width characters, Rug Pull, permission audit, supply-chain and agentic risk. Local-first: no code leaves your machine. Features pre-install guardrail gating, OpenAPI auto-discovery and embeddable security badges.

tools.description: Full security scan of an MCP server / AI skill / agent (GitHub URL). Returns 5-dimension score + OWASP coverage + detailed findings.
